Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: assays, activities, compound_structures, molecule_dictionary. Join: assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id, activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217644', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, activities.standard_relation IS NOT NULL. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, molecule_chembl_id ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC.
